notes.subject: כי
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'כי לא ידעתי' is 'for I do not know [how] to flatter'; 'bilong mi no save' fronts the purpose reading.

notes.subject: כמעט ישאני
notes.rationale: 'in a little my Maker lifts me away' — KJV reads consequence of flattering, YLT temporal 'soon take me away'.

notes.subject: עשני
notes.rationale: 'Man i wokim mi' keeps the participle 'my Maker'; 'Wokim-Man bilong mi' would be more literal but awkward.

translation: Bilong mi no save long givim gutpela nem; sapos mi wokim olsem, long liklik taim Man i wokim mi bai karim mi i go.
